items.title: refactor(telegram): remove legacy reply-cache fallbacks (#164173)
items.summary: refactor(telegram): remove legacy reply-cache fallbacks (#164173) Require canonical version-1 reply-cache rows and use recorded message identities for transcript deduplication. Historical unversioned projections become cache misses without deleting their stored bytes; markerless replies may appear in both context and transcript. Independent P2 review and exact-head CI passed. Shared remote proof passed 109 cases, the changed gate, canonical packaging, and the unmodified published 2026.9.7 update. Real Telegram Test Server proof preserved exact reply ancestors and links across restart, with confirmed cleanup. The retained observations were validated without repeating live messages. Production +9/-42/net -33. Full proof, measured test costs, and intentional cache behavior are recorded in the PR.

items.title: fix: every attachment send fails when a channel mediaMaxMb is 0 (#163…
items.summary: fix: every attachment send fails when a channel mediaMaxMb is 0 (#163701) Fixes #163700. When a channel set `mediaMaxMb` to 0 or a negative value, `resolveAttachmentMaxBytes` turned it into a 0-byte cap, so every attachment send failed with `Media too large ... (limit: 0 bytes)`. Matrix, LINE and Zalo schemas accept such values. A non-positive cap is now treated as unset, matching the existing rule in `src/media/configured-max-bytes.ts`. Positive limits are unchanged. Proof: a built Gateway sent through the `message` action and the real Matrix plugin to a local Matrix stand-in (Crabline plus an upload stub). Base rejected a 68-byte PNG at limit 0. This change uploaded the identical bytes and delivered an `m.image` with caps of 0 and -5. A tiny positive cap still rejects before upload, and unset still succeeds. The regression tests fail on base and pass here. A live gpt-5-mini smoke call passed. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
